bio_en: Harutyun Hambardzumian, known by the revolutionary name Lorto (Van dialect for 'mighty, strapping'), was born in 1867 into a large patriarchal family in the Ararq quarter of Aygestan in Van. After parish school he worked from the age of twelve in his father's linen workshop, bakery and wine trade. In 1892, when Peto came from the Caucasus to organise the ARF in Vaspurakan, Lorto joined the party against his parents' wishes. He took part in the preparations of the Van parties in 1896 to obtain arms and fighting bands, and in the Van self-defence that followed.
